subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should native sub-agent completion control become one unified routing enum, and should that enum also have a persistent `agents.defaults.subagents` default?
rationale: Deterministic suppression is clearly missing, but overlapping skip, parent-routing, and per-channel requests plus the repository's high config-surface bar require an intentional public contract before implementation.

options.title: Per-spawn unified enum first
options.body: Add a typed `parent | channel | none` spawn control and defer persistent config until the contract has proven necessary.

options.title: Enum plus default config
options.body: Add the same typed policy per spawn and under `agents.defaults.subagents`, retaining current behavior as the backward-compatible default.

options.title: Keep token control
options.body: Retain the current announce chain and exact silent-token mechanism without adding public API or config.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn unified enum first
recommendation.body: Add a typed `parent | channel | none` spawn control and defer persistent config until the contract has proven necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects Peter to `sessions_spawn`, the announce pipeline, and the core product contract.
